filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Before I Go to Sleep
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her. (Thriller, Drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. (Drama, Crime drama) - 2000

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Action, Thriller) - 2006

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jonny enters the world of professional drifting as competes in the famous Gatebil show in Norway, driving a specially modified BMW M5. To give himself a fighting chance, he first arranges some tuition from the 2011 British Drift Champion Matt Carter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E15 Vicki Butler-Henderson is joined by Norwegian rally prodigy Andreas Mikkelsen for a high octane motoring triathlon - race in a 200bhp off-road buggy, perform an autotest in a Škoda Fabia hot hatch, and battle wheel to wheel in single seat race cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E01 Vicki tests two cars, the Lotus Exige S vs. Caterham CSR; Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Land Cruiser; Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black; Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of power sliding.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson is at Anglesey for another shoot-out; his time it's super chic superminis, the BMW Mini One against the Fiat 500; Jason Plato delivers his verdict on the Nissan Skyline now re-badged as the GT-R.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E07 Vicki is at the controls in a classic Ford v Vauxhall battle, two boy racer specials, the Fiesta ST and Corsa SRi, wage war to find out which is fastest; Tom journeys to the Arctic Circle to test the Volvo XC70, an estate car with four-wheel drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Anglesey for another Fifth Gear shoot-out. This week it's the Porsche Cayenne GTS against the BMW X5. Tom Ford drives the new C5 and Tiff Needell tests the new Subaru Impreza STi.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is quickest, the VW Golf GTI or Subaru Impreza WRX; Jonny Smith proves there are still some cars that you can buy for under $1,500.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E10 Vicki takes the Focus RS and the Escort Cosworth to find out once and for all which handles best around a track; Jason drives the Grand Tourer and delivers his verdict whether the £78,000 asking price would represent money well spent.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E01 Tim Shaw joins the team, and he's been specially tasked with standing up for the beleaguered motorist; Jason Plato and Tiff Needell go head-to-head on the track to find out which car is fastest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E02 Tiff Needell takes two coupes onto the Fifth Gear track, the Mazda RX8 and Nissan 350Z; Vicki Butler-Henderson spends a day with Formula One star Lewis Hamilton; Tom Ford is the lucky man behind the wheel of the facelifted Mercedes SL63 AMG.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E03 Jason Plato races two estates head to head; Vicki Butler-Henderson pits the new Pro-Ceed against the VW Golf; Jonny Smith picks up an amazing luxury car for £1000 or less; Tiff Needell runs the most exciting car vs. bike race to date.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E04 Jason Plato pitches a lunatic Honda Civic Mugen RR imported from Japan against a Honda S2000 sports car from the UK; Jonny Smith tests the VW Passat CC v Mercedes CLS; Tiff Needell takes to the track to test the brand new KTM X-Bow.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tiff and Jason race two V8 mega-saloons. Tom has the only television test of the Dodge Challenger.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E06 Tim Shaw tests whether manufacturers' claimed 0-62mph acceleration times are actually true or not; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads out to the track in two Porsches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E07 Tom Ford tests the brand new Ford Fiesta; Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell challenge each other on two wheels; Jonny shows us three great cars we could all suddenly afford to buy if we were to all stop drinking.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E08 Jason and Tiff battle against each other in the purest form of motor-sport: karting; Dirk Benedict joins Jonny Smith in a luxury road test with a difference; Tom Ford tests the Renault Laguna.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E09 Jason meets Moto GP star James Toseland in a feature where "Fifth Gear" makes a sports star's dream come true.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S14 E05 Tom Ford puts the Grande Punto Abarth through its hot hatch paces; Tim Shaw finds out if it's possible to save huge amounts of money by servicing a car yourself; Bruno Senna is a special guest presenter.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E01 Tiff and Jason head for the racetrack in the KTM X-Bow and Lotus 2-Eleven; Jonny investigates the smarter and apparently plusher qualities to be found in the latest Golf; Tom conducts a crash test which is essential viewing for all families.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E02 Jason pits the tiny Renault Sport Twingo 133 against the Renault 5 GT Turbo; Tom finds out Vauxhall's replacement for the Vectra; Tim relives the terror of his driving test to find out why fewer people than ever are passing their test.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E03 Jason pits two diesel coupes against each other; Jonny braves the freezing weather to show off three cabriolets, with a budget of just £5,000; Tom puts the Ford Fiesta against the Seat Ibiza in three tests; Tiff drives the Lamborghini Gallardo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E04 Vicki talks with the young rally sensation Tom Cave; Jason is at the annual Race of Champions.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E05 Jason and BBC Radio 1 star Comedy Dave recreate a Ford Capri car chase scene from '70s UK TV show "The Professionals." Tim tests different car polishes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E06 Tiff pits Renault's Mégane hatch against a Caterham CDX sports car; Tim delves into the murky world of car crime; Jonny gives a consumer review of the new Ford Ka.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E07 Tiff tests hatches including the Ford Focus RS; Vicki looks at a second-hand Lotus Elise; Quentin examines the personalized number plate market.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki meets 12 times Motor Trials champion and British motorcycling legend Dougie Lampkin; Jonny investigates another way of making cash from old cars; Jason takes the Ford Focus RS in the first TV drive of Ford's awesome new hot hatch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E09 Tim finds out which car washes are effective -- and which ones can permanently damage a car's paint.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S15 E10 The Vauxhall Astra GTE 16v and Ford Escort RS Turbo take on the Fifth Gear test track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S16 E01 Featuring a death-defying loop-the-loop stunt, a race against David Coulthard, and a test to see if buying an old car can beat the credit crunch.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S23 E16 Vicki Butler-Henderson is in Italy testing the most powerful Ferrari ever made, the brand new 730bhp F12berlinetta, to the limit. Tiff and Jason are at the track with the two cheapest hot hatches on sale - the Suzuki Swift and Renault Sport Twingo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki goes behind the scenes of famous Italian car designers Pininfarina - the people who have shaped every single Ferrari of the last 50 years. Tiff is joined by British rally star Mark Higgins in a test of two new SUVs with supercar power figures.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 18 Tiff is joined by German motoring legend, Sabine Schmitz, for a head-to-head battle between our two favorite sports cars of the last year, the BMW M6 and Porsche 911.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jason Plato and Tiff Needell hold a high octane track test of three brand-new super glamorous convertibles from Audi, Maserati and Mercedes. Vicki Butler-Henderson races wheel to wheel with World Superbike hotshot Chaz Davies.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell pit what could be the greatest drivers' car of the century - the Toyota GT86 - against its tough rival from Renault Sport. Jonny Smith is in Spain to put Jaguar's brand new F-Type through its paces.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Jonny Smith reveals the secrets of 21st century car crash testing. He goes behind the scenes at a crash test performed by experts Euro NCAP, before conducting his own shocking crash test between a car and a van.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Episode 4 Tiff Needell heads to LA to check out the latest car trend to take the USA restomodding; it's the art of sympathetically restoring classic cars to modern standards while retaining their original charm, Tiff's behind the wheel of LA's best examples.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Bengaluru vs. Pune - Finals
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E19 It's the moment of truth! Championship Sunday has arrived for the World Pickleball League (WPBL) as the Bengaluru Jawans take on Pune United for the title. Prepare yourself for an intense matchup -from Men's Singles right through to Mixed Doubles!

pickletv.us.title: Breaking Pickleball : S01E06 - The Championship
pickletv.us.description: S1 E6 The final two teams battle it out for the Orchard Championship Cup.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Mixed Pro Doubles - Gold Medal Match
pickletv.us.description: S1 E43 Anna Leigh Waters and J.W. Johnson take on Megan Fudge and Andrei Daescu in this Mixed Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

pickletv.us.title: All Florida Pro League : O Town Bangers vs St Pete Iceburgs
pickletv.us.description: S1 E25 The O Town Banggers face off against the Saint Pete Icebergs in the final afternoon match. Both teams undefeated, aiming for the finals against Miami Blaze. Key moments highlight strategic plays and errors.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Delhi - Day 4 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E8 The World Pickleball League Season 2 returns to the Jio World Garden in Mumbai for an electrifying Tie 8 showdown. The defending champions, Bengaluru Jawans—led by coach Oliver Strecker and backed by owners Atlee and Priya—return to the court for the first time since their dominant opening night performance. They face a determined Delhi Dilwale squad, coached by Wesley Gabrielsson, who are looking to climb the standings after a hard-fought tie-break victory in their previous outing.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : North Carolina vs. Utah Tech
pickletv.us.description: S2024 E2 The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

pickletv.us.title: Breaking Pickleball : S01E01 - The Start
pickletv.us.description: S1 E1 The Arizona Pickleball League is created -- 5 teams in the league, 4 teams make the playoffs, 1 will not. Meet Kyle Koszuta of the Tempe Tornadoes.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Kao/DeHeart vs. Fudge/Munro
pickletv.us.description: S1 E14 Watch a thrilling Mixed Pro Doubles pickleball match between the top-seeded team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro against Peichuan Kao and Ryler DeHeart. Megan Fudge is a highly-ranked professional player who previously played tennis at the University of Illinois, where she met her husband and partner, Ryler DeHeart. DeHeart is a former professional tennis player who is left-handed. Their opponents are Peichuan Kao, a professional pickleball player who won gold at the APP Fort Lauderdale Open, and Jack Munro, a young pro who was the youngest to become a professional at age 12.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Liberty vs. Carnegie Mellon
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E22 Live from Virginia Beach, this Week 3, Day 2 matchup of the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 features Liberty University facing Carnegie Mellon University. Liberty enters the match strong, having already secured wins in women's doubles. The broadcast highlights the Men's Doubles game where Liberty's Derek Kraje and Ben Rice dominate with a 11-6 victory, utilizing aggressive net play and strategic resets.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : - Men's Pro Split Doubles - Semifinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E6 Senior Pro’s Andre Mick & Jose Derisi battles against Altaf Merchant & John Cincola at the Naples, Florida.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2023 : – Mixed Doubles Final – Yates & Wuerffel vs Bright & Hafez
pickletv.us.description: S2 E10 In the exciting championship match of Picklebowl 2023, pro pickleball player Kyle Yates teams up with Picklebowl host and former NFL quarterback Danny Wuerffel to challenge the fierce duo of Anna Bright, a top female pro and former collegiate tennis star, and Ameen Hafez. This charity event brings together athletes and celebrities representing their alma maters in a competitive battle for the Picklebowl trophy. Commentary by Dave Fleming and special guest Marcellus Wiley highlights the skill, strategy, and drama on court. Watch intense rallies, strategic plays, and hear insider insights as these top players compete for the title. Don’t miss the dynamic energy and social spirit of pickleball in this must-see final.

pickletv.us.title: All Florida Pro League : AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 3 - Old Town Bangers vs. Fort Myers Flamingos
pickletv.us.description: S1 E4 This episode provides courtside commentary on Game 3 of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, featuring the Fort Myers Flamingos and the Old Town Bangers. The commentators highlight the aggressive play of newcomer Jada Bui and the defensive prowess of Ellie Schele. They also discuss the importance of mental toughness and team chemistry in a high-pressure environment. The episode concludes with a preview of the upcoming men's match.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : US Open 2023 – Wheelchair Hybrid Doubles 5.0 Gold Match – Krizmanich & Lipp vs Huletsky & Sylvestre
pickletv.us.description: S1 E23 Don’t miss this inspiring wheelchair hybrid doubles match from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships. Adaptive athletes Rob Krizmanich, Michael Lipp, Patick Huletsky, and Jeff Sylvestre bring talent, teamwork, and tenacity to the court in a showcase of the sport’s inclusive future.

pickletv.us.title: The Wager : Troubadour Club 2024 – Exhibition Match – Johnson & East vs Kennedy & Burrows
pickletv.us.description: S1 E5 Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - Utah Valley University vs. Louisiana State University
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E10 The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center reaches a fever pitch as Utah Valley and LSU clash in a high-stakes, sudden-death battle for survival. This elite matchup showcases the "Racing" speed of Ethan Martin against the tactical "Skills" of Rachel Gauff in a contest where every point determines who advances in the bracket. With a $1,000 bounty on the line, both teams engage in a fierce "Freestyle" display of collegiate athleticism that proves why new powerhouses are emerging on the national stage.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Women's Pro Singles - Quarterfinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E1 Jorja Johnson faces off against Simone Jardim in this match-up of the Women's Pro Single Quarterfinal.

pickletv.us.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball : - December 13 2022 - All Stars Mixed Doubles
pickletv.us.description: S1 E5 December 13, 2022 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball : 2023 – AZ PBL Team Match – Gladiators vs Tornadoes
pickletv.us.description: S1 E14 Tune in for a high-energy match between the Gilbert Gladiators and the Tempe Tornadoes at The Orchard in Scottsdale, Arizona. This April 25, 2023 episode of Tuesday Night Pickleball features fast-paced action and strategic plays as both teams battle it out in a pivotal match. With sharp shots, effective communication, and critical moments, the Gladiators and Tornadoes go head-to-head for a thrilling finish. Watch as the teams showcase their pickleball prowess in one of the most exciting events of the AZ PBL season.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E23 The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.

pickletv.us.title: VANTA Blackwater Team Cup : Vanta Stingrays vs Yield Point Wranglers
pickletv.us.description: S1 E1 Vanta Stingrays and Yield Point Wranglers face off in a women's doubles match. The women set the tone with their speed and energy. It's a humid day, making the ball difficult to handle.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Women's Senior Pro Doubles - Bronze Medal Match
pickletv.us.description: S1 E33 Molly Carter and Kim Kesner take on Pam Ruoff and Erica Marsh in this Women's Senior Pro Bronze Medal Match.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2022 : – Mixed Doubles – Patterson & Taylor vs Fudge & Anderson
pickletv.us.description: S1 E8 The 2022 Picklebowl offers an unforgettable mixed doubles match featuring some of the biggest names in sports. US Olympian Casey Patterson and pickleball pro Chuck Taylor join forces to take on pickleball standout Megan Fudge and former tennis world No. 5 Kevin Anderson. Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: Inside DUPR Pickleball : Episode 2
pickletv.us.description: S1 E2 This episode tackles pickleball sandbagging, one of the sport’s most debated topics. Plus, an interview with pro Glauka Carbajal-Lane, Sunny’s Coaching Tip of the Week featuring three essential drills, and a conversation with Zach Hunter of Hyperspace Ventures and the Palm Beach Royals.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Women's Pro Doubles - Semifinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E37 Leigh Waters and Anna Leigh Waters take on Parris Todd and Yana Newell in this Women's Pro Doubles Semifinal Match.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Mixed Pro Split Age - Backdraw Semifinal

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

outlaw.us.title: Diablo
outlaw.us.description: A young Civil War veteran (Scott Eastwood) embarks on a quest to save his kidnapped wife (Camilla Belle) from a band of ruthless Mexican bandits. (Western, Thriller, Action) - 2015

outlaw.us.title: 3:10 to Yuma
outlaw.us.description: Outlaw Ben Wade (Russell Crowe) terrorizes 1800s Arizona, especially the Southern Railroad, until he is finally captured. Wade must be brought to trial, so Dan Evans (Christian Bale), the owner of a drought-stricken ranch, volunteers to escort him to the train. Along the trail, a grudging respect forms between the men, but danger looms at every turn, and the criminal's men are in pursuit. (Western, Drama) - 2007

outlaw.us.title: The Ballad of Cable Hogue
outlaw.us.description: After he is abandoned in the desert without water, Cable Hogue (Jason Robards) wanders for days until he finds a supply of water in a muddy ditch. Determining that the spot is the only spring in the area, Cable decides to start a business offering water to passing stagecoaches. Aided by his new friend, Joshua (David Warner), and a prostitute named Hildy (Stella Stevens), Cable builds a successful business. However, when motorcars start to pass, Cable realizes his trade is down to its last days. (Comedy, Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
outlaw.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: Tall in the Saddle
outlaw.us.description: Cowboy Rocklin rides into a dusty western township where he's been promised work on a ranch. But when he finds that his future boss has been gunned down, he's forced to find work elsewhere. Despite his sexist attitudes, Rocklin charms the fiery Arly with his cavalier bravado and lands a job at her family's ranch. There, however, he learns that Judge Garvey was involved in his original employer's murder and is now trying to steal the dead man's land. (Western) - 1944

outlaw.us.title: Carson City
outlaw.us.description: After one too many successful stick-ups of the Carson City stagecoach by the Champagne Bandits, the local banker decides to build a railroad track through town. To do so, he'll need to employ the help of "Silent" Jeff Kincaid (Randolph Scott), the only man who can tunnel through the mountainous region. Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: Guns of Diablo
outlaw.us.description: A wagon master is confronted by a man he wounded years before in episodes from "The Travels of Jamie McPheeters." (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: Vengeance Valley
outlaw.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. (Western) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: The Rounders
outlaw.us.description: Ben Jones (Glenn Ford) and Howdy Lewis (Henry Fonda) are cowboys who spend their days breaking horses and flirting with two sisters (Kathleen Freeman, Joan Freeman). When Ben and Howdy trade Ol' Fooler, an unbreakable horse, for corn liquor, the client returns the horse after it passes out from drinking whiskey. The cowboys grow fond of Ol' Fooler and, knowing that he is nearly impossible to ride, enter the horse in the rodeo hoping to make their fortune. (Western, Comedy) - 1965

outlaw.us.title: Tall Man Riding
outlaw.us.description: A few years ago, Larry Madden (Randolph Scott) left his fiancée, Corinna (Dorothy Malone), after a run-in with her father, the wealthy landowner Tucker Ordway (Robert Barrat). After saving a man (William Ching) from a vicious attack, Larry learns he is actually Corinna's new husband, and that some of the locals are preparing to challenge Tucker's land ownership. When Larry decides to ride back into town and make a claim himself, he encounters a few unexpected obstacles. (Western) - 1955

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne
outtvproud.us.description: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task. (Fantasy, Horror, Adventure, Action) - 2005

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward). (Horror, Western, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
outtvproud.us.description: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal. (Action, Horror) - 2010

shadesofblack.us.title: The Forgiven
shadesofblack.us.description: During his life sentence in post-apartheid South Africa, brutal murderer Piet Blomfeld seeks redemption through meetings with Archbishop Desmond Tutu. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

shadesofblack.us.title: Morris From America
shadesofblack.us.description: A 13-year-old rapper (Markees Christmas) focused on hip-hop stardom falls for a rebellious classmate (Lina Keller) after moving from the U.S. to Germany with his widowed father (Craig Robinson). (Comedy drama) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: NOLA Circus
shadesofblack.us.description: A rivalry between competing barbershops in New Orleans escalates until it affects the owners' families and friends. (Comedy) - 2015

shadesofblack.us.title: Meet the Blacks
shadesofblack.us.description: When some unexpected money comes his way, Carl Black moves his family from cold and windy Chicago to bright and sunny Beverly Hills, Calif. As the Blacks settle into their beautiful new home, they start to notice some strange behavior in the neighborhood. Nighttime is approaching, and President El bama announces that the annual purge is about to begin. Carl and his loved ones must now endure a 12-hour period of lawlessness before they can enjoy life once again. (Comedy) - 2016

shadesofblack.us.title: Snoop Dogg's Hood of Horror
shadesofblack.us.description: The Hound of Hell (Snoop Dogg) is a guide through three stories from a neighborhood of depraved citizens. There is a tagger who discovers that not all gangsters die hard, a foolish Texas oil fortune heir who kills for money but can't afford to stay living, and a huge rap star who uncovers a few skeletons in his dressing room that try to kick down his door. (Horror) - 2006

shadesofblack.us.title: Crash
shadesofblack.us.description: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon). (Drama) - 2004

shadesofblack.us.title: American Violet
shadesofblack.us.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Monster's Ball
shadesofblack.us.description: Hank, an embittered racist prison guard working on death row, begins an unlikely, emotionally charged sexual relationship with Leticia, a Black woman and wife of a man sentenced to death. The affair begins just after Hank oversees the capital punishment of Leticia's husband. (Drama, Romance) - 2001

shadesofblack.us.title: Never Back Down
shadesofblack.us.description: Jake (Sean Faris) moves to Orlando, Fla., with his mother (Leslie Hope) and brother (Wyatt Smith). He feels like an outsider in his new school and frequently lets his temper flare out of control. But Jake wants to fit in, and he decides to go to a party with his classmate Baja (Amber Heard). There, Jake is pushed into a fight and humiliated. Another classmate (Evan Peters) sees what happened, and encourages Jake to visit martial arts trainer Jean Roqua (Djimon Hounsou). (Action) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Falcon Rising
shadesofblack.us.description: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead. (Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Thriller, Drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
shadesofblack.us.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets. (Action, Comedy) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction. (Comedy) - 2008

tastemadetravel.us.description: Gualberto "Weber" Elizondo surprised his family when his grilling hobby turned him into a local celebrity and internet sensation. Meanwhile, chef Chuy Villareal of Cara De Vaca wants the world to know that the north of Mexico isn't just carne asada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad. (Cooking) - 2022-09-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
tastemadetravel.us.description: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Piloncillo
tastemadetravel.us.description: The Garza family invites Pati to their vineyard to help the community make piloncillo - and it's hard work! Then, in the magic town of Bustamante, three sisters make traditional bread in adobe ovens. (Cooking) - 2025-10-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Pioneering From Farm to Table
tastemadetravel.us.description: Spicy honey, garlic and orange roasted duck; skillet corn tamal with duck fat and roasted garlic. (Cooking) - 2022-10-20

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cantina Culture and the Morning After?
tastemadetravel.us.description: Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
tastemadetravel.us.description: Wedding rice; ginger and pistachio guacamole. (Cooking) - 2022-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: The Pizza City You've Never Heard Of
tastemadetravel.us.description: Disturbed by the fact that his hometown of Windsor, Ontario is typically overlooked on lists of the top pizza cities in the world, George Kalivas goes on a mission to set the record straight about where to find the best pies on the planet. (Documentary) - 2022-09-21

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

truecrimenetwork.us.description: One quiet afternoon, two women are brutally murdered while two small children watch and hide. The case goes unsolved for years until investigators wonder if the murders match another killing on the other side of the country. (Science)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - Amy Bishop
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Neuroscientist Amy Bishop is denied tenor, and it results in deadly consequences for her co-workers. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - Murder in Miami
truecrimenetwork.us.description: While her 10-year-old daughter listens upstairs, failed self-help guru Derek Medina shoots his wife during an argument, then casually posts pictures of her dead body on Facebook. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Murder USA - PORTILLO
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When Sheila Jo Hanks is found dead inside her home, investigators uncover a history of domestic abuse and escalating violence; the tragic case becomes a powerful examination of coercive control, warning signs and a family left searching for answers. (Legal)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Heartland Homicide - Kurt Douglass Johnson
truecrimenetwork.us.description: On New Year's Eve in Cooperstown N.D., an intoxicated Kurt Johnson is given a ride home from a local bar; when it's discovered that Kurt never arrived home, authorities begin their search, and what they uncover shocks them to their core. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - The Exchange Student Murder
truecrimenetwork.us.description: An exchange student finds a career and a love match in the idyllic Missouri university town of Columbia; it's a shock to her friends and family when she disappears, leaving both her child and cellphone behind. (Documentary)

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Fortified Cottonseed
waypointtv.us.description: Joining John Sewell and Laramie Barrett from Fortified Cottonseed; Laramie gets to see first hand how their product works in the field as John has implemented it 365 days a year.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Hunting Land Man - Turkey Tombstone
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Flips And Flops
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E10 Slade breaks down what's involved in taking a raw land tract and creating extremely desirable turn-key hunting properties; Caleb and Slade double up on some gobblers for Caleb's first turkey kill ever.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Opening Day in Mississippi
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 A look at turkey hunting in southwest Mississippi with Cragg Fitz during the opening week of turkey season.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Summer Time Activities
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E15 Slade is staying busy around the house and testing summer plots with Deergro and Backwoods bachelor pad blend; he takes a quick look at the new 60 acres he and Ryan bought as an investment property; a throwback hunt from under the barn.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Asa's First Turkey!
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Hunting Next to a Haunted House
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E05 Historic St. Francisville, La., holds the "old South" feel that is ever so fleeting; hunting on a local property and getting a beautiful long-bearded turkey on the ground.

waypointtv.us.title: LBP Spotlight : Mike Mahoney
waypointtv.us.description: TA Mahoney is a classic mom-and-pop store known for going the extra mile and treating everyday people like family; keep an eye on Mike though, you never know what kind of prank is up his sleeve.

waypointtv.us.title: LBP Spotlight : Josh Calhoon
waypointtv.us.description: Josh and his wife Anna own the most prolific tackle shop in Fort Walton Beach. Josh's family eats, sleeps and breathes fishing.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Tensas Parish
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E05 Slade gets very busy in the real estate world; Caleb Armstrong takes up the slack and sets out to hunt swamp bucks on the public land of Tensas Parish.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : The Plan for POPE!
waypointtv.us.description: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade does more summer food plot prep in hopes Pope will make an appearance! With Rain on the way Slade is able to disk and seed his Pope Summer spot!

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Doe Patrol
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E06 Hunting season is swiftly coming to an end; the real estate world is getting busier; Slade and his family set out to fill some tags and fill up the freezer.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Duck Land Man
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E07 Slade takes Bentley on his first duck hunt; Slade gets to take a fun trip to duck hunting paradise with some buddies of his.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Midwest Turkey Tour 2024
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Thunder
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E08 The 2024 turkey season has arrived. Slade and Bentley are already off to a great start. Bentley managed to take one down during opening weekend for youth hunt and Slade takes one down opening day.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Eddie Jaramillo
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E09 U.S. Marine Corps veteran Eddie Jaramillo speaks about his life of continued service as he and host Jay Garstecki get tattoos from one of the country's premier tattoo artists.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Dave Allen
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E01 Motorcycle junkie and Army veteran Dave Allen recounts the terrifying prospect of facing chemical warfare during Operation Desert Storm with host Jay Garstecki and guest Paul Sr. from American Choppers.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : John Arroyo
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 Shot through the neck at Fort Hood in Texas, U.S. Special Forces Green Beret Captain John Arroyo recounts coming face-to-face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would-be killer.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Ginger Gilbert-Ravella
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Ginger Gilbert-Ravella honors the memory of her husband, Major Troy Gilbert, a USAF Pilot and American hero.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Intrepid Care
waypointtv.us.description: Texas is a land rich and plentiful, and one of the country's most sought-out destinations to hunt wild game; its hunting culture is driven by family and values, and the trophy itself is embedded within the experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Cable Smith
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E07 Cable is a huge supporter of Texas Hunting and everything Texas Trophy Hunters.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Cole Dutton
waypointtv.us.description: Texas is a land rich and plentiful, and one of the country's most sought-out destinations to hunt wild game; its hunting culture is driven by family and values, and the trophy itself is embedded within the experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Women Go Hunting
waypointtv.us.description: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Father and Son Hunt
waypointtv.us.description: We follow along with the crew from Struttinbuck on their annual Father Son hunt at FE Hill. No matter what happens throughout the year this is always a must-have trip and a time to settle down and enjoy the great outdoors.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Show your Skull
waypointtv.us.description: We're back with Double T Outfitters for this episode of Storytellers, filmed at the beautiful Las Lagunas Ranch in South Texas! This hunt was one to remember as we spent time with the Price family.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Trinity Oaks; Bucks for the Brave
waypointtv.us.description: Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support armed forces veterans and first responders to share their stories and unite all in honoring and recognizing their service to the nation.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Border Bucks
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E05 Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season; friends from Struttinbuck do just the same, as Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks on the Mexico border.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Flat Rocks and Fire Trucks
waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Option to Upgrade
waypointtv.us.description: Capt. Blair heads down to Naples to fish the Gulf with Capt. Mike Avignon.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Triple-Tailed -- Solo
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E03 Capt. Blair fishes solo near Cape Canaveral; on his return trip, he experiences an unexpected encounter at the buoys; the surprise adds excitement to his solitary fishing day.

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Starbrite Double Feature
waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Remote Mountain Ice Fishing
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E08 Kyle Green meets up with some friends at the Idaho Fish & Game to travel by snowmobile to remote lakes in the mountains of Idaho to ice fish for cutthroat trout.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : The Maine Moose
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E09 In the season finale, Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Maine to hunt for moose and learn about the conservation of this species which is under attack by winter ticks.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Upper Peninsula Trout Adventures
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E10 Kyle Green and his childhood friends are in his home state of Michigan for a trout fishing adventure; they visit dynamic landmarks, cliff jump, and finish out the trip cooking trout riverside.

waypointtv.us.title: The Green Way Outdoors : Fishing Hawaii
waypointtv.us.description: Kyle and Jeff explore the oceans off the coast of Hawaii; they encounter sharks, manta rays and even jump off a 40-foot cliff.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Crazy Rut Chaos in Georgia
waypointtv.us.description: Bouncing around in a Summit climber proves to be a risky tactic for Bryan Brown as he is able to get tight to the bedding area where five bucks are chasing one hot doe.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips
waypointtv.us.description: S05 E15 Tag along with Nick Mundt as he chases BIG mule deer in the Nebraska Sand Hills during the gun season opener.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Road Trips - MASSIVE February MONSTER ----- Bill Jordan's Louisiana Buck
waypointtv.us.description: Realtree's Bill Jordan finally gets the invite to hunt with his son Tyler at the world famous Honey Brake Lodge in Louisiana. Honey Brake is a part of the Deer Management Assistance Program (DMAP) which allow them to harvest whitetails into February.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Kansas Flyer Buck
waypointtv.us.description: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand; everything comes together in a moment that bow hunters dream about.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Seek One Turkey Hunt - Perfect Hunt Off Roost
waypointtv.us.description: Realtree/Seek One hunt giveaway winner Jake Snyder is joined by Seek One hosts Drew Carroll and Lee Ellis as well as Tyler Jordan for a turkey hunt on Realtree Farms; Jake's hunt is as perfect as possible off roost.

waypointtv.us.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation : Better Than We Found It
waypointtv.us.description: Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's, addresses the care of natural resources for future generations; Ziehmer asserts it is the responsibility of citizens to leave resources in better condition for the future.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: The Chikee Larkin and Michael set out on a Florida Man adventure in Part 1 of this 2-part series; join them in the Florida Keys and Everglades for an experience that few get to experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: Lucky Tuna Michael and Larken end their trip to Florida with an epic day of offshore fishing with Captain Chris Trosset.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: The Beginning Spending a full day on the water with his son, Larkin; teaching him, watching him learn and seeing the joy on his face; from chasing Bull Reds to sharing the places that shaped me growing up.

waypointtv.us.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
waypointtv.us.description: Holy Smokes Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness; after serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : An American Icon
waypointtv.us.description: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour takes ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Another World
waypointtv.us.description: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

waypointtv.us.title: The Direction : Tribute to Veterans, Father and Son
waypointtv.us.description: We are at West Boggs Lake in Indiana for annual veterans' appreciation day. We are joined by Jeff and James Hall. Father and son. It was a great day just saying thanks to them for their service.

waypointtv.us.title: The Direction : Bassin' and Reminiscing
waypointtv.us.description: Mark is with guest and great friend Jimmy Jennings. Jimmy helped get The Direction, Marks dream of filming outdoor TV, to reality. His team at One Call Concepts supported Marks idea of delivering The Call 811.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Knowledge : Local Knowledge - Marathon
waypointtv.us.description: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we're experiencing it with one of the area's most respected captains.

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : Live Fishing Report
waypointtv.us.description: S09 E03 PCB Fishing Report author Capt. Nathan Chennaux joins Capt. Justin scanning the beach waters for tarpon, and they hook into a monster while maneuvering around storms and vacationers. Does it make it into the boat?

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Baby Tarpon with Captain Mason Baker
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E06 Capts. Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Capt. Mason Baker to sample some early morning Islamorada backcountry baby tarpon action.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Islamorada Bonefishing With Captain Mason Baker
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E07 After a successful morning of baby tarpon fishing, Captains Tom Rowland, Rich Tudor and Mason Baker slide over to the legendary downtown Islamorada flats to check on the resurgence of Florida Keys bonefish.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Everglades Redfish out of Key Largo
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E08 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head into the Everglades backcountry out of Key Largo to fish the shallow grass flats for tailing redfish.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Gulf Monsters with Captain Garrett Stephens
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E09 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Saltwater Experience Charters' Captain Garrett Stephens for a trip into the Gulf; when their catches get repeatedly cut off, they haul the massive bull sharks to the surface for a closer look.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Cobia Fishing with Captain Garrett Stephens
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E10 Captains Tom Rowland, Rich Tudor, and guest Captain Garrett Stephens encounter some cobia after wrestling with massive bull sharks; they use up all their strength and skill to keep these fish away from the sharks.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Islamorada Paddle Board Fishing
waypointtv.us.description: S19 E11 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use the 26' Yellowfin Hybrid to bring their Live Paddle Boards to an Islamorada flat; they have a fun day fishing for bonefish, and later, they encounter some toothy critters.

wipeoutxtra.us.description: S03 E06 Twenty Brits tackle the purpose-built Argentinean course.

wipeoutxtra.us.title: Wipeout Australia
wipeoutxtra.us.description: S01 E02 The Ball Crusher Sweeper is the star of tonight's show; a brother-sister team hanging by a thread.

wipeoutxtra.us.title: Total Wipeout UK : Folge 6
wipeoutxtra.us.description: S06 E06 Twenty brave battlers including a grave digger, a pet detective and a whisky taster take on the wintry weirdness; five take on Winter Blunderland, but only three contestants will survive it and become heroes.

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Foraging in the Old Stone Age
truehistory.us.description: The Paleolithic Era is the longest time in human history; understanding this period is crucial for comprehending the human history that follows, including how family dynamics, migration patterns, climate change and more affect life in this era. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Origins of Agriculture
truehistory.us.description: Debating why and how humanity transitions from foraging to agriculture; delving into the agricultural revolution; how some combination of climate change, population growth and human ingenuity leads to a revolution in human history. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Power, Cities, and States
truehistory.us.description: The next major transition in human history is the rise of cities; introducing life in the early farm communities; Professor Benjamin investigates the origins of power; its relationship to the state; the abiding features of the world's early cities. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: A History of India - Earliest History of the Indian Subcontinent
truehistory.us.description: Beginning one's study millions of years ago; plate tectonics shape the subcontinent's mountains, plateaus and river systems; these affect the region's aspects; reviewing South Asia's four macro-regions; how geography guides the course of life. (World history) - 2016-04-29

truehistory.us.title: A History of India - Migration and the Adivasi
truehistory.us.description: Three main cultures inhabit the ancient Indian subcontinent; studying the Adivasi, who once comprise the entirety of South Asia's population; how genetic and linguistic analysis shows the Adivasi of 30,000 years ago; their status in India today. (World history) - 2016-04-29

truehistory.us.title: A History of India - Indus Valley Civilization
truehistory.us.description: Turning to the urban people of the Indus Valley; many mysteries abound regarding this long-lost Bronze Age civilization; exploring excavated cities; examining art and artifacts; what people know about this society; what may have happened to them. (World history) - 2016-04-29

truehistory.us.title: A History of India - Indo-European Vedic Culture
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the ancient foundations of Hinduism, which emerge from people who identify themselves with the Vedas; studying these poems and hymns; the civilization's culture and cosmology; the origins and development of the Indo-European language. (World history) - 2016-04-29

truehistory.us.title: A History of India - Caste: Varna and Jati
truehistory.us.description: The Vedic caste system is one of the most well-known and misunderstood aspects of Hindu society; the ancient Vedic social order; how it structures society; how numerous inherited social groups relate to occupation; a diverse and complex society. (World history) - 2016-04-29

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - What Does It Mean to Be Human?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring human development and the considering questions about early life. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - Stones and Bones: The First Fossil Families
truehistory.us.description: Homo habilis, the earliest known species of the genus. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - Bio-Cultural Adaptation andHomo erectus
truehistory.us.description: Meeting Homo erectus, the first of the genus to walk completely upright. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - HowHomo sapiensLeft Africa
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the roles of gene flow and the exchanges of artifacts, ideas and social structure. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - X-Woman! Meet Our Ancient Relatives
truehistory.us.description: Discovering the complexity of early human history by meeting Denny, a female specimen. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.title: Early Humans: Ice, Stone, and Survival - Did the Neanderthals Really Go Extinct?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the culture-rich lives of the Neanderthals, who existed for more than 300,000 years across a vast geographic space. (World history) - 2023-04-21

truehistory.us.description: Tracing the origins of the human species from the emergence of proto-humans to the rise of Homo sapiens, Professor Benjamin offers perspectives to show what makes the human species unique and why it has been able to flourish. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Foraging in the Old Stone Age
truehistory.us.description: The Paleolithic Era is the longest time in human history; understanding this period is crucial for comprehending the human history that follows, including how family dynamics, migration patterns, climate change and more affect life in this era. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Origins of Agriculture
truehistory.us.description: Debating why and how humanity transitions from foraging to agriculture; delving into the agricultural revolution; how some combination of climate change, population growth and human ingenuity leads to a revolution in human history. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Big History of Civilizations - Power, Cities, and States
truehistory.us.description: The next major transition in human history is the rise of cities; introducing life in the early farm communities; Professor Benjamin investigates the origins of power; its relationship to the state; the abiding features of the world's early cities. (World history) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: A Guided Tour of Ancient Egypt - The Major Museums of Cairo

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: A Guided Tour of Ancient Egypt - How to Build a Pyramid

amc.ca.title: Poltergeist
amc.ca.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings - Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) - when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Movie, Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.ca.title: Creepshow
amc.ca.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Movie, Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena - before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room. (Movie, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2007

amc.ca.title: Pumpkinhead
amc.ca.description: After his son dies in a hit-and-run accident, Ed Harley seeks revenge against the teenagers responsible. With the help of a local witch, Ed summons the vengeful demon Pumpkinhead to hunt and kill the group of friends. But when Ed discovers a bond between himself and the creature, he begins to have second thoughts about employing the vicious monster, and he fights to end Pumpkinhead's murderous rampage before it is too late. (Movie, Horror) - 1988

amc.ca.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
amc.ca.description: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial - all designed to kill millions of children. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.ca.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
amc.ca.description: The apparently comatose Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur) is being transferred from one hospital to another, but he wakes up when the ambulance crew talk about his surviving niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris). After slaughtering his attendants, Myers sets out to find his one living relative who is, fortunately, being cared for by a kind and resourceful foster sister named Rachel (Ellie Cornell). Meanwhile, the ever-cautious Dr. Loomis (Donald Pleasence) remains on the killer's path. (Movie, Holiday, Horror) - 1988

amc.ca.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.ca.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Movie, Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.ca.title: Halloween II
amc.ca.description: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

amc.ca.title: Halloween
amc.ca.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Movie, Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

babytv.ca.description: S02 E02 Paint Splashes Ellie and Ducky are having fun playing with paint, but Ellie must clean themselves up in the bath as they cannot go to sleep covered with paint splashes.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found
babytv.ca.description: Bubble Adventures The friends make bubbles in the water as they go on an underwater adventure inside a bubble. They see fish, jellyfish, a crab, and a friendly juggling octopus.

babytv.ca.title: Look What I Found

babytv.ca.description: S01 E13 Train The friends have built a beautiful train and want to hop on board for an exciting ride.

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies

babytv.ca.title: Cuddlies
